facts.statement: A video with developer Ryan Shannon gave an overview of the Sunstone Valley adventure zone; the page title says 'part two' (deuxième partie).
facts.quote: Ryan Shannon de l'équipe de développement

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades?
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language official freerealms.com news page (the article body is in French) that links a video in which Ryan Shannon of the development team gives an overview of Free Realms' new adventure zone, Sunstone Valley (Vallée des pierres de soleil). The page gives no date beyond a relative 'published 1 month, 2 weeks ago' and no zone details beyond the video introduction.
